location_fine: candlelit period set and home kitchen
visual_synopsis: This video is a compilation of two unrelated segments. First, on a black candlelit set, two men in white face powder and 18th-century costume (one in a curly white wig, red cape and lace gloves, the other with dark curls and a red cravat) deliver alternating pieces to camera, with a photograph of two modern men inserted partway through. Second, in a bright kitchen, a man in a green sweater and a wife played in drag (ginger curly wig, loud patterned housecoat) fight with a big glass preserve jar until he finally wrenches the lid off, laughing, and she snatches it back.
